events.title: Many promotion and relegation issues remain undecided on the penultimate Saturday of the League season. In the First Division, six of the bottom seven lose, the exception being 루턴 타운 who beat 아스널 3–1. 선덜랜드 look doomed following a 4–0 home defeat by 애스턴 빌라. 버밍엄 시티 and 헐 시티 confirm their promotions while 달링턴 are poised to join 체스터필드, Bury and 블랙풀 in going up from the Fourth Division.

에버턴 beat 퀸스 파크 레인저스 2–0 in front of over 50,000 at Goodison Park and are league champions for the first time since 1970. 선덜랜드 lose 2–0 at 레스터 시티 and are relegated. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 go down to the Third Division despite beating 허더즈필드 타운 2–1 in front of a crowd of 4,422, the lowest ever for a league match at Molineux . The second half at 노츠 카운티 is delayed by half an hour as 맨체스터 시티 fans riot with their team 3–0 behind. County eventually run out 3–2 winners to improve their chances of avoiding relegation and deal a blow to City's promotion hopes.
브래드퍼드 시티 경기장 화재 — 잉글랜드 브래드퍼드의 밸리 퍼레이드 경기장에서 경기 도중 화재가 발생했다. 목조 관중석과 경기장 안전을 둘러싼 큰 비극이었다.
56 spectators die in a fire at Valley Parade in a match between 브래드퍼드 시티 and 링컨 시티 .
Wealdstone F.C. become the first winners of the Non-League Double ( Gola League & F.A. Trophy) , defeating Boston United 2–1 at Wembley Stadium .

A black day for English football. Fifty-six people are burnt to death and more than 200 others injured at Valley Parade , Bradford in a fire caused by a discarded cigarette which set light to waste beneath the wooden main stand. The speed with which the blaze spread was astonishing. Tragedy also at 버밍엄 시티 where rioting 리즈 유나이티드 fans hold up play and later cause the collapse of a brick wall, killing a 15-year-old boy. 맨체스터 시티 beat 찰턴 애슬레틱 5–1 and clinch promotion to the First Division ahead of 포츠머스 on goal difference while at the other end 노츠 카운티 and 카디프 시티 are relegated. 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 secure the Second Division title with a 4–0 win over 반즐리. 밀월 are promoted from the Third Division but 프레스턴 노스 엔드 and Orient go down to be joined by either 스완지 시티 or 번리. 에버턴's unbeaten run of 28 league and cup matches comes to end as they go down to a Garry Birtles goal at 노팅엄 포리스트.
노리치 시티 win 2–1 at 첼시 in their final match of the season, meaning 코번트리 시티 – held 0–0 at 입스위치 타운 – must win their remaining three matches to stay up and send the Canaries or 웨스트햄 유나이티드 down instead.

에버턴 lift the European Cup Winners' Cup with a 3–1 win over Rapid Vienna in Rotterdam . Second half goals from Sharp, Steven and Sheedy clinch their second trophy of the season and keep alive hopes of a "treble" with the FA Cup final to follow.

에버턴 F.C. won their first European Cup Winners' Cup after defeating SK Rapid Wien of Austria 3–1 in the final at the Feijenoord Stadion in Rotterdam after goals from Andy Gray , Trevor Steven and Kevin Sheedy in the 58th, 72nd and 85th minutes respectively. Hans Krankl got the consolation goal for SK Rapid Wien in the 84th minute.

웨스트햄 유나이티드 secure their First Division status with a 1–0 win at 입스위치 타운 while 코번트리 시티 win by the same score at 스토크 시티 to retain a chance of survival. 스완지 시티 hold 브리스틀 시티 to a goalless draw, a result which relegates 번리 to the Fourth Division.

맨체스터 유나이티드 win the FA Cup for the sixth time, beating 에버턴 1–0 thanks to a goal by Norman Whiteside in extra time. United played with only 10 men following the 77th minute dismissal of defender Kevin Moran for a foul on Peter Reid , the first ever sending-off in an FA Cup final.
After sinking as low as 20th earlier in the season, 리버풀 clinch the runners-up spot with a 3–0 win at 웨스트햄 유나이티드 in their penultimate League match.

An 84th-minute goal by Brian Kilcline gives 코번트리 시티 a dramatic 1–0 win over Luton and edges them closer to First Division safety. 에버턴 beat 리버풀 1–0, their third such win over the deposed champions this season. John Wark misses a penalty.
코번트리 시티 beat 에버턴 4–1 to complete their "great escape." Milk Cup winners 노리치 시티 are relegated despite finishing on 49 points, the highest total ever recorded by a team relegated from the top flight.
루턴 타운 beat an understrength 에버턴 2–0 in the final match of the League season.
헤이젤 참사 — 브뤼셀에서 리버풀과 유벤투스의 유러피언컵 결승을 앞두고 관중석 충돌과 붕괴가 일어났다. 인명 피해와 경기 개최 결정은 이후에도 큰 쟁점으로 남았다.

Thirty-nine spectators, most of them Italian, are killed when a wall collapses at the European Cup final between 리버풀 and 유벤투스 at the Heysel Stadium in Brussels . Despite the tragedy, the match is played and 미셸 플라티니 scores from a penalty as 유벤투스 win 1–0. UEFA later bans all English clubs indefinitely from European competitions as a result of the disaster. Just hours before kick-off, Joe Fagan had announced that he would be retiring as 리버풀 manager after two seasons in charge.

39 spectators die at the Heysel Stadium disaster at the final of the European Cup between 유벤투스 FC and 리버풀 F.C. The Old Lady became the first club in the history of European football to have won all three major UEFA competitions after defeating the English team.
